jobs.note: docs/208 §8.2 env apply on BP. PASS = 0 crashes, no freeze; the satb-act checks (A1-A3 0, satbMode 2, satbConc > 0, workExc 0) and the offload3-moder ones for env (A2 == 0, exc == 0, A4 < 30% of items). Apply: autoff_env_ready > 0 and autoff_env_applied > 0 (the sim used worker answers at the game's own call), autoff_env_apply_none / _apply_stale = the fallbacks to the game's own code (report the shares). Equivalence (autoffdry on in this job): autoff_env_dry_eq / autoff_env_dry (answer = live driver at the Sim's update; go-live wants >= 99%), autoff_env_apply_dry_eq / autoff_env_applied (the same over the applied answers), autoff_env_game_eq on the game's own updates. Any apply crash or exception: stop (EnvApply = the game's method with the scan replaced).
